note: Machine-readable expected values for every fixture. Tests assert against these numbers, so a fixture edit that changes its motion must update this file too. Every value is measured from the fixture source, never guessed.

hover-tilt.html.description: #tilt rotates to -12deg and scales to 1.08 on :hover over 300ms
hover-tilt.html.note: No load animation: --trigger load on this page must yield a static capture.

scroll-reveal.html.description: 10 sections x 400px, #progress scales 0->1 over the scroll range; reveals fade in on IntersectionObserver
scroll-reveal.html.note: Only the scroll-timeline #progress is numerically asserted; IntersectionObserver reveal timing is not frame-deterministic.

marquee.html.description: 12 x 100px items translating 0 -> -1200px over 2000ms, linear, infinite

canvas-2d.html.description: 9 seeded orbiters + progress arc, drawn on rAF from performance.now() only
canvas-2d.html.note: The determinism fixture. Uses a seeded mulberry32 PRNG, never Math.random().

gl-three.html.description: three.js box rotating on y/x, driven by performance.now()
gl-three.html.note: Imports three from ./vendor/ — never a CDN — so CI is offline-safe. Needs an http:// origin because ES modules are CORS-blocked on file://.

clip.mp4.note: 9.4 KB, committed. Regenerate with: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=160x120:rate=10:duration=1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 28 clip.mp4

canvas-random.html.description: 40 particles laid out with the page's real Math.random(); the control fixture that proves --seed is wired
canvas-random.html.note: Deliberately uses Math.random so a different --seed MUST change the frames. Paired with canvas-2d (own PRNG), which must not change with --seed.

scale-in.html.description: 3 tiles, scale(0.6)->1 + opacity 0->1, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 800ms, stagger 110ms. The only fixture that animates a uniform scale, which the tracker exposes as scaleX+scaleY while the stylesheet declares one `scale`.
